name: 56377 · Sartell, MN
findings: ZIP 56377 (Sartell) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56377 (Sartell) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56377 (Sartell) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).
